items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe. Utica, New York, November 6, 2010 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I don’t know look at Esperanza Spaulding, you know, a good example.

ctx.x: Is there a thing about just feeling more exposed to the audience if it’s just you and the microphone? You know when you have a bass you’ve got this other thing.

Yeah I know, and I have had people say to me over the years you should just really put the bass down. I don’t know look at Esperanza Spaulding, you know, a good example. She is out there playing and singing, and now she is really doing a whole lot of different stuff. I’m not caught up on her latest material but you know, she’s doing it in her way. It’s very interesting, but she’s playing and singing. And honestly I’m feeling now that the bass lines I’m playing when I play the bass actually dictates how I sing so…
